Every Ocean View Archives novel stays faithful to its narrator’s lived point of view—such as Michael’s first-person narration in The Rachel Narrative, Nathaniel Prairie’s first-person perspective in Katie & Nathaniel, or Jordan’s close third-person point of view in The Eleventh Child. Housing hallway briefings, closed-door meetings, and staff dispatches inside RaggieSoft Backstage protects chapter immersion while rewarding curious readers with the full story behind the curtain.

Whenever a chapter on RaggieSoft Book Reader has a companion dossier, a Behind the Scenes / Bonus Feature card appears at the end of the chapter. Selecting it opens the dossier right inside your reading view without losing your spot—or you can explore the complete archive directly here on RaggieSoft Backstage.

Yes! Select Install App in the top bar (or Share → Add to Home Screen on mobile devices) to install RaggieSoft Backstage alongside RaggieSoft Book Reader and The Listening Room with offline access across all 43 records. Select Appearance at any time to switch between Light, Dark, or device-matched lighting, five distinct visual styles, and four editorial color palettes.

Fictitious Persons, Universities, Bands & Entities Disclaimer: All narrative characters, bands (including The Stardust Engine, Fractured Prisms, Crimson Node, The Paper Wall, Mana Canvas, The Arctic Symphony Project, and Teller County), biographies, universities and schools (including Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute / CPI, Virginia Dominion University / VDU, The Forgers, The Crucible, Eleanor Bennett Commonwealth Hall, Callahan Hall, Kincaid Commons, and Morrison Middle School), academies and theme parks (including Tidewater Tumblers, Lynnhaven Academy of Seondu, Seonduwon, and Brewster Gardens), corporations (including OmniCorp, Vectron Energy Corp., Quantum Corporation, Apex Records, Prairie Coachworks, and Sainte-Claire), transit agencies (Coastal Virginia Transit Authority / CVTA, Blue Ridge Transit, Bluewater Transit, Roanoke Valley Transit, Radford Transit, and Mountain Valley Transit), in-universe administrative correspondence, legal filings, and any entity with “LLC”, “Trust”, or “Holdings” in its name (including Engine Room Records, LLC, The O'Connell Family, LLC, Artists First Management, LLC, Stardust Properties, LLC, Stardust Blacksburg, LLC, Stardust Strategic Assets, LLC, Pacific Rim Properties, LLC, Jessica Miller Center, LLC, and Aethelgard Holdings, LLC) are 100% works of fiction inside the RaggieSoft universe. Any resemblance to actual persons (living or dead), universities, businesses, institutions, or events is purely coincidental. In real life, there is only Engine Room Records (no “LLC”), the real-world creative brand under which Michael P. Ragsdale distributes his music.
